findings.evidence: Article body: 'shall be equipped with a vehicle approach warning device ... to notify pedestrians and others of the vehicle's approach'. UN R159 is the Moving Off Information System (MOIS) for pedestrian/cyclist detection on M2/M3/N2/N3; the AVAS regulation is UN R138 (Quiet Road Transport Vehicles).
Body covers high-pressure gas, LPG, and compressed hydrogen fuel systems. UN R34 is fire-risk prevention (liquid fuel tanks); gaseous fuel counterparts are R67 (LPG), R110 (CNG/LNG), R134 (hydrogen).
Body: 'springs or other suspension components ... sufficient capacity to absorb ground impacts'. UN R79 is steering equipment, unrelated to suspension.

findings.proposed: ["UN R125"] (R125 driver forward field of vision); drop R123
findings.evidence: Body: driver's field of vision, cargo partition, head-up display. UN R123 is Adaptive Front-lighting Systems, unrelated.
Body concerns windshield wiper, washer and defroster fitment; UN R125 covers forward field of vision of the driver, not wipers/washers/defrosters (EU regs 1008/2010, 672/2010 cover those).

Body: 'technical standards ... closely related to the properties of fuels ... shall be established so as to ensure safety ... when the fuels prescribed by ministerial notice are used'. It is a fuel-quality premise clause, not a CO2 (R101) or emissions (R83) requirement.

findings.proposed: ["Passenger accommodation / egress"] (no emergency-exit tag in taxonomy; remove lighting tags); also add un_equivalent_ai UN R107
findings.evidence: Body is emergency exit location/size and marking of exit and opening method; no lighting or tell-tale requirement. Bus counterpart UN R107 not mapped.
Body has no lighting content; Lighting modules tag appears spurious.
Body para 4 requires reliable software modification (R156 software update) and para 5-6 high-voltage occupant protection (R100); only R10 and R155 are listed.
Body para 1-2 is child restraint anchorages (ISOFIX/i-Size anchorages are UN R145); R129 covers the child restraint system itself (para 3).

notes: All 28 records are single articles of the Ministerial Ordinance on Safety Regulations for Road Vehicles (JVSR) from e-Gov (source_url identical, law 326M50000800067); status in-force is consistent, no repeal wording except individually '(Deleted)' sub-items inside live articles (art1 item 3, art29 para 5), which is fine. Bodies contain real regulation text (translated), but each article only states a general duty and defers numeric limits to ministerial notices (Safety Regulations Details Notice); the UI 'full text' should not imply technical limits are included. Precheck body-thin flags for art12 and art28 dismissed: those articles are genuinely one paragraph. Summaries are truncated with '...' mid-sentence (e.g. art1, art10, art14, art21, art26) which is cosmetic. Titles/citations use 'Article 11_2' style while body uses 'Article 11-2' (cosmetic). Main systemic issue: un_equivalent_ai mappings are keyword-driven and often wrong for subjects with no UN counterpart (art14, art12, art21, art43-7). UN R168 (RDE) on art31 and R26/R125 on art2/art29 are loose but not clearly wrong; not flagged. UN R162/R116 (art11-2), R160 (art46-2), R158 (art44-2), R138 (art30) were checked and are correct.
